line_audit.claim: The headline reports n=2^30, k=1040, and a genuine improvement over k=31.

line_audit.claim: The field, polynomial basis, evaluation set A, inner domain Y, coordinate ordering, and generator rows are deterministic.
line_audit.justification: The irreducible modulus and coefficient orders are fixed. The coordinate formula is bijective, and the 65·16 listed monomials are an F_2-basis of P_64.

line_audit.claim: p(Z)=Z^16+Z^5+Z^3+Z^2+1 is irreducible over F_2.
line_audit.justification: The Frobenius residues and Euclidean identities recompute exactly. Since 2 is the only prime divisor of 16, the displayed 2^8 gcd condition and 2^16 Frobenius condition are precisely the needed criterion. The citation metadata matches the [Rabin paper](https://epubs.siam.org/doi/10.1137/0209024).

line_audit.claim: H realizes an explicit binary [32768,16,16384] affine Reed-Muller code.
line_audit.justification: H is F_2-linear; evaluations at 0 and the unit vectors recover all coefficients. H(1) is all-one, while every other nonzero symbol has nonzero linear part and is balanced.

line_audit.claim: Evaluation on A gives an exact [32768,65,32704] code over F_{2^16}.
line_audit.justification: Degree at most 64 evaluation is injective on 32,768 distinct points. The root bound gives distance at least 32,704, and a product over 64 evaluation points attains the outer distance.

line_audit.claim: The final code is binary linear, has exact length 2^30, and dimension 1040.
line_audit.justification: Both maps are binary-linear and injective. The coordinate count is 32768^2=1,073,741,824 and the message dimension is 65·16=1040.

line_audit.claim: Every nonzero codeword has weight at least 535,822,336.
line_audit.justification: A nonzero degree-at-most-64 polynomial has at least 32,704 nonzero evaluations, and each corresponding inner block has weight at least 16,384. Their product is exactly 535,822,336.

line_audit.claim: The minimum-distance lower bound is attained by the displayed L_U.
line_audit.justification: Independent field arithmetic reproduces every coefficient and image value. The mask annihilates L_U(A) but not 1, so L_U has 64 zero blocks and 32,704 balanced blocks, giving exact weight 535,822,336.

line_audit.claim: The dimension-1039 balanced core and direct-sum decomposition are correct.
line_audit.justification: The coefficient constraint has codimension one and excludes the constant polynomial 1. The exact fiber formula bounds every nonzero core word on both sides, and injectivity gives C=B⊕<1^n>.

line_audit.claim: The complete generator matrix is output deterministically in polynomial time.
line_audit.justification: For each fixed row and coordinate, bounded-size field arithmetic computes α^ia^j and then the affine bit. The algorithm emits all 1040n entries in O(n) fixed-parameter bit operations, with no search or oracle.

line_audit.claim: The cited Griesmer bound applies throughout the endpoint audit.
line_audit.justification: Every residual object is a binary linear code, exactly the stated hypothesis. The formula and bibliography match [Griesmer's paper](https://doi.org/10.1147/rd.45.0532), and all numerical sums were independently recomputed.

line_audit.claim: The Delsarte polynomial criterion is invoked with its hypotheses satisfied.
line_audit.justification: Both polynomials have nonnegative Krawtchouk coefficients, positive constant coefficient, and are nonpositive at every allowed nonzero distance. This is the standard bound from [Delsarte's monograph](https://users.wpi.edu/~martin/RESEARCH/philips.pdf). The proof summarizes rather than displays the character-square identity, a nonblocking exposition point.

line_audit.justification: A second kernel vector would split the support into two nonzero words of total weight w<2d. Comparing a lift with its translate by the residualizing word yields the stated distance inequality.
